h22_atlas.use: Rank only. No extrapolated Budget8/12/16/20/24 KL value is treated as measured.

question: At the same exact average nominal capacity as uniform Budget16, can the frozen H22 layer ranking move enough slabs from tolerant layers to sensitive layers to restore the route12 terminal boundary?
intervention: Both arms set route limit 12, use the same frozen H22 ranking, keep the exact nominal sum 1472 slabs across 92 layers, leave retained route weights unchanged, and disable schema/position rescue.

gate.go: An arm must match the Budget24-reference top-1 with positive teacher margin, reduce KL(Budget24||arm) by at least 20% versus route12/uniform16, and measure <=0.90 logical GiB/provider-position.
gate.no_go: If neither arm passes, stop quartile H22 average-16 allocation. Do not tune quartile membership on this fixture.
gate.next_if_go: Run only the lowest-KL passing policy on one separately preregistered full get_weather sequence with schema rescue.
gate.production: No production transplant from this discovery position.

limitations: H22 directly measured isolated Budget96 terminal KL on one calibration stream; its rank transfer to composed Budget8--24 policies is the hypothesis under test.
Budget24 is a behaviorally successful reference, not native exact K3; reported KL is reference-to-arm.
One terminal boundary cannot establish broad quality.
Quartile allocation is a coarse discriminator, not a claimed optimum.
Cold token-sequential timing is not serving throughput.
